SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status != 50 THEN 1 END) AS goingCount, COALESCE(ROUND( AVG(CASE WHEN status = 50 AND expend_time IS NOT NULL THEN expend_time END),1 ),0) AS avgHandleTime, ROUND( IFNULL( (COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 50 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100,0 ),2 ) AS oneTimeRate, COALESCE(ROUND( AVG(CASE WHEN response_time IS NOT NULL AND SOURCE IN ('person','alarm') THEN response_time END),1 ),0) AS firstHandleTime FROM bbx_work_order where deleted = 1
and tenant_id =#{tenantId}

SELECT COALESCE(department_name, '其他') AS name, COUNT(*) AS totalNum, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 50 THEN 1 END) AS completeNum, COUNT(CASE WHEN status != 50 THEN 1 END) AS noCompleteNum FROM bbx_work_order WHERE deleted = 1
and tenant_id =#{tenantId}
GROUP BY department_id, department_name
ORDER BY totalNum DESC
ORDER BY totalNum asc

SELECT ROUND( CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) / (COUNT(*) * 1.0) * 100 END, 2 ) AS rate FROM bbx_work_order WHERE deleted = 1
and tenant_id =#{tenantId}
